LightningComponentBundle.description: Imports CSV files into Salesforce: upload and preview, map columns to fields, review the rows and import them.

property.name: importObjectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: The object the rows are imported into, e.g. Contact. Without it, users enter the object in the wizard.

property.name: maxFileSizeMb
property.label: Maximum File Size (MB)
property.description: The largest file in megabytes that can be read.

property.name: maxRows
property.label: Maximum Rows
property.description: The most rows a file may have, not counting the header.

property.name: externalIdFieldApiName
property.label: External ID Field
property.description: Upserts the rows by this field, e.g. an external ID field or Id: rows with the value of an existing record update it, the others create new records. Without it, every row creates a new record.
